items.title: Collaborative Museology
items.abstract: The so-called crisis of representation, the profound questioning of knowledge claims based on positivist principles since the 1980s, has had an enormous impact upon anthropology and related academic disciplines and fields. In many ways, the debates and contestations rage on, and associated problems—methodological, epistemological, ethical, etc. —remain unresolved.
